qualification_policy: Apply reviewed points/pairs/order only. Do not restore excluded workers, duplicate exposure, superseded versions or individual eligibility.

image_decisions.regularity_requirement: Do not treat true nonorthogonal walls as annotation error; use task/GT-consistent criterion. Exact implementation pending.

confirmed_policy.gt_reference: Treat selected GT as correct for this quality study, except explicitly identified reference issues.
confirmed_policy.regularity: Regularity must affect total quality where applicable to the annotation rules; true nonorthogonality is not itself an error.
confirmed_policy.shared_small_scope: Must not be ignored. Screen candidates algorithmically; human verifies acceptable crop/closure before new scope reference.
confirmed_policy.glass_and_minor_details: Do not automatically create alternative GT or compensation for glass-side choice or minor protrusions in this simplified study.
confirmed_policy.oos_uncomputable: OOS and point count >=8 alone are insufficient. Retain computable annotations; unresolved historical pairing is not proof of geometry failure. Do not force repair of already explicitly uncomputable OOS.
confirmed_policy.no_majority_truth: Majority scope is a screening signal, not truth.

research_questions: How to evaluate coexisting accepted small and large scopes without rewarding omission?
Whether to use fixed cropped/full references with one formula, or a simpler justified alternative.
How to define task-compatible regularity for x8-09 without unnecessary complexity.
unapproved_options: Remove only the intrinsic orthogonality discount on x8-09
Compare matched corner angles to GT
Two fixed scope references with one quality formula
Report target-conditional quality and full-GT coverage separately
